## Findings
- claim-1: For \(t\in\mathbb Z\), let \(P(t)=0\) if \(t<0\), and, for \(t=6u+r\ge0\) with \(0\le r<6\), set \[ P(t)= \begin{cases} 3u^2+3u+1,&r=0,\\ 3u^2+4u+1,&r=1,\\ 3u^2+5u+2,&r=2,\\ 3u^2+6u+3,&r=3,\\ 3u^2+7u+4,&r=4,\\ 3u^2+8u+5,&r=5. \end{cases} \] Then \(P(t)=\#\{\lambda:\ell(\lambda)\le3,\ |\lambda|=t\}\).
- claim-2: For \(b\ge1\), put \(R_b(N)=\#\{\rho\subseteq b^3:|\rho|=N\}\). Its complete piecewise quasi-polynomial formula is \[ R_b(N)= \begin{cases} 0,&N<0\text{ or }N>3b,\\[2pt] P(N),&0\le N\le b,\\[2pt] P(N)-P(N-b-1)-P(N-b-2)-P(N-b-3), &b<N\le\lfloor3b/2\rfloor,\\[2pt] R_b(3b-N),&\lfloor3b/2\rfloor<N\le3b. \end{cases} \]
- claim-3: The complement \(\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_3,b-\rho_2,b-\rho_1)\) is an involution of partitions in \(b^3\) and gives \[ R_b(N)=R_b(3b-N). \]
- claim-4: Conditional on the accepted graded integral basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^3}\mathbb Z e_\rho\), \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), one has \[ \operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}=R_b(N),\qquad Q_{ij+N}=0\quad(N\notin[0,3b]), \] and every \(Q_{ij+N}\) is free abelian, hence torsion-free.
## Strategy
Let \(P(t)=0\) for \(t<0\). From
\[
\frac1{(1-q)(1-q^2)(1-q^3)}
=\sum_{c\ge0}q^{3c}\sum_{a,b\ge0}q^{a+2b},
\]
\[
P(t)=\sum_{c=0}^{\lfloor t/3\rfloor}
\left(\left\lfloor\frac{t-3c}{2}\right\rfloor+1\right).
\]
For \(t=6u+r\), splitting \(c\) into even and odd values gives:
\[
\begin{array}{c|cccccc}
r&0&1&2&3&4&5\\ \hline
P(6u+r)&
3u^2+3u+1&
3u^2+4u+1&
3u^2+5u+2&
3u^2+6u+3&
3u^2+7u+4&
3u^2+8u+5.
\end{array}
\]
Thus \(P(t)\) counts partitions of \(t\) with at most three parts.

The rectangle generating function is
\[
\sum_{N\ge0}R_b(N)q^N
=\prod_{k=1}^3\frac{1-q^{b+k}}{1-q^k},
\qquad
R_b(N)=\#\{\rho\subseteq b^3:|\rho|=N\}.
\]
Put \(M=\min(N,3b-N)\). Complementation
\[
\rho^\vee=(b-\rho_3,b-\rho_2,b-\rho_1)
\]
is a weight-reversing involution, so \(R_b(N)=R_b(3b-N)\). Since
\[
M\le\left\lfloor\frac{3b}{2}\right\rfloor<2b+3,
\]
no product of two numerator terms contributes to \([q^M]\). Hence the nonrecursive formula is
\[
R_b(N)=
\begin{cases}
0,&N<0\ \text{or}\ N>3b,\\[2mm]
P(M)-P(M-b-1)-P(M-b-2)-P(M-b-3),
&0\le N\le3b.
\end{cases}
\]
Together with the six displayed residue clauses for \(P\), this is a complete explicit piecewise quasi-polynomial formula.

Conditional on the accepted graded integral basis
\[
Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^3}\mathbb Z e_\rho,
\qquad \deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|,
\]
it follows that
\[
\operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}=R_b(N),
\qquad
\operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+N}
=\operatorname{rank}Q_{ij+3b-N}.
\]
Moreover \(Q_{ij+N}=0\) for \(N\notin[0,3b]\), and every graded piece is free abelian, hence torsion-free.

The requested target is established conditional on that accepted graded-basis statement.

## Gaps
The underlying graded integral basis of \(Q\) is used as accepted project context and is not reproved here. Therefore the rank, vanishing, and torsion conclusions remain conditional on it.
